title: WCAG 1.4.12 text-spacing overrides and growing containers
statement:
WCAG 1.4.12 (Level AA) requires that no content or functionality is lost when users override line height to 1.5 times, paragraph spacing to 2 times, letter spacing to 0.12 times and word spacing to 0.16 times the font size, so containers, buttons and navigation items on a landing page must grow with their text.

Options:
- Flexible-height components: Auto-height containers (min-height rather than fixed height) for cards, buttons and navigation items (fits: robust, technical, modern)
- 1.5 line-height default: Default body line-height of 1.5 so user overrides change little (fits: accessible, calm, editorial)
- Wrapping labels: Labels allowed to wrap (no white-space: nowrap on labels that can grow), so widened letter spacing does not clip tabs or nav items (fits: practical, careful, responsive)
- Text-spacing test pass: Pre-launch check of hero, pricing cards and footer using a text-spacing bookmarklet or extension (fits: systematic, professional, polished)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web. Audience: general.

source.title: Understanding SC 1.4.12: Text Spacing, Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1
